title: Repair the Dangling Pipeline
prompt: Implement `firstLetters(std::vector<std::string> words)`: return the uppercase first letters of long words as a **std::string** — computed through a view pipeline over `words`, but returned by value so nothing dangles after the call.

tests.name: returns a value, not a view
tests.hint: Build the pipeline over the (by-value, caller-owned-copy) words parameter, accumulate into a std::string, return the string — the view dies inside the function, the value survives.

tests.name: works through the by-value copy
tests.hint: The parameter is a copy — mutating/adapting it inside is safe; the caller's vector is untouched.
